say:9:1410242005:1.text: Hiding? Please! I'm a bomb maker! It'd be reckless to test explosives on the surface!
say:9:1410242005:1.source_cn: 这不叫躲！你看到了，我是个造炸弹的！哪怕是出于安全考虑...
say:9:1410242005:1.male: Hiding? Please! I'm a bomb maker! It'd be reckless to test explosives on the surface!
say:9:1410242005:1.female: Hiding? Please! I'm a bomb maker! It'd be reckless to test explosives on the surface!

say:10:1410242006:1.text: Isn't it more reckless to detonate bombs underground? What if the whole place collapses?!
say:10:1410242006:1.source_cn: 说什么呢，在地下起爆引起塌方不是更危险吗？！

say:11:1410242008:1.text: Down here, I've got resources, peace, and no interruptions. Perfect for research.
say:11:1410242008:1.source_cn: 我在这里搞研究，这里资源丰富又没什么人，最适合不过了！

say:12:1410242009:1.text: Do they even know you're making bombs beneath their feet?
say:12:1410242009:1.source_cn: 你在地下研究武器，深岩村的人不知道吗？

say:13:1410242010:1.text: So what if they do? My research is so far from the village.
say:13:1410242010:1.source_cn: 知道又怎么样？我的研究所在地下，离深岩村远着呢。

say:14:1410242011:1.text: I don't bother them; they don't bother me. Everyone's happy.
say:14:1410242011:1.source_cn: 我没打扰他们，他们犯不着撵我走啊。各忙各的，井水不犯河水。

choice_prompt:15:1410242011.text: I don't bother them; they don't bother me. Everyone's happy.
choice_prompt:15:1410242011.source_cn: 我没打扰他们，他们犯不着撵我走啊。各忙各的，井水不犯河水。

say:16:1410242012:1.text: Ask Eldric if you don't believe me!
say:16:1410242012:1.source_cn: 你不信，自己去问问那个什么弗林好了。
say:16:1410242012:1.male: Ask Eldric if you don't believe me!
say:16:1410242012:1.female: Ask Eldric if you don't believe me!

say:17:1410242014:1.text: You guys figure out how to get back to the surface on your own. I'm busy!
say:17:1410242014:1.source_cn: 你们自己想办法回地表吧！我要接着做研究了！

choice_prompt:18:1410242014.text: You guys figure out how to get back to the surface on your own. I'm busy!
choice_prompt:18:1410242014.source_cn: 你们自己想办法回地表吧！我要接着做研究了！

say:19:1410242015:2.text: Ugh... I guess I had a tiny part in you coming down here...
say:19:1410242015:2.source_cn: 我才不要？又不是我——呃，虽然好像确实有我一份功劳……
say:19:1410242015:2.male: Ugh... I guess I had a tiny part in you coming down here...
say:19:1410242015:2.female: Ugh... I guess I had a tiny part in you coming down here...

say:20:1410242017:1.text: Meeting you guys was such bad luck... I'll take you back to the surface.
say:20:1410242017:1.source_cn: 唉……遇到你们算我倒霉。好吧好吧，我带你们返回地表。

say:21:1410242018:1.text: But listen up! We'll have to take a detour, and you need to follow my lead. No second-guessing me!
say:21:1410242018:1.source_cn: 不过，先说清楚哦！想回地表得绕远路，你们得听我的，别随...

say:22:1410242019:1.text: As long as you get us back safely, we'll forgive you!
say:22:1410242019:1.source_cn: 只要你老老实实带我们返回地面，我们就原谅你！

say:23:1410242020:1.text: Hmph! Bossy little furball, aren't you? Fine, fine.
say:23:1410242020:1.source_cn: 嘿！得寸进尺的小仓鼠！算了，我不跟你计较——

say:25:1410242021:1.text: But first, who are you people?
say:25:1410242021:1.source_cn: 现在，总能告诉我你们是谁了吧？

say:26:1410242022:1.text: I'm Hammie. This is Chippy, and this is our magister.
say:26:1410242022:1.source_cn: 我是漫漫，他是满满，这位是我们的主人——
say:26:1410242022:1.male: I'm Hammie. This is Chippy, and this is our magister.
say:26:1410242022:1.female: I'm Hammie. This is Chippy, and this is our magister.

choice_prompt:27:1410242022.text: I'm Hammie. This is Chippy, and this is our magister.
choice_prompt:27:1410242022.source_cn: 我是漫漫，他是满满，这位是我们的主人——
choice_prompt:27:1410242022.male: I'm Hammie. This is Chippy, and this is our magister.
choice_prompt:27:1410242022.female: I'm Hammie. This is Chippy, and this is our magister.

say:28:1410242023:1.text: A mage, huh? Don't see many of those around here...
say:28:1410242023:1.source_cn: 唔，魔法师……？在这里很少见到啊……
say:28:1410242023:1.male: A mage, huh? Don't see many of those around here...
say:28:1410242023:1.female: A mage, huh? Don't see many of those around here...

say:29:1410242024:1.source_cn: 祖娅，你在打什么坏主意吗？

say:30:1410242025:1.text: Hey, take it easy. I was just making an observation.
say:30:1410242025:1.source_cn: 说好的别随随便便怀疑我！我只是感慨而已！

say:31:1410242026:1.text: But seriously, what's your business in Brimstone Village?
say:31:1410242026:1.source_cn: 不过，你们来深岩村干什么呀？

say:32:1410242027:1.text: We're with the imperial envoy, here to check on the village's weapon production. We didn't expect—
say:32:1410242027:1.source_cn: 我们陪同耀光的特使大人，来检查深岩村的武器生产进度！没...

say:33:1410242028:2.text: Oh, weapons, huh? That's their deal, not mine. Don't lump me in with them. If you want answers, wait until I kindly haul you up to the surface. Then, you can interrogate whoever you want.
say:33:1410242028:2.source_cn: 噢，武器生产。我可跟他们没关系，别想套我的话。想调查，...

say:34:1410242029:1.text: But enough talking! If you want out, we go through my lab.
say:34:1410242029:1.source_cn: 话都说这么久了，别在这瞎站着。先回我的研究所吧，返回地...

say:35:1410242030:1.text: You gotta follow and keep up, alright?
say:35:1410242030:1.source_cn: 我带路，你们跟着，行不行？

say:38:1410242032:1.text: And don't touch anything! My equipment is delicate!
say:38:1410242032:1.source_cn: 先说好！我的研究所里有一堆精密仪器，你们进去了不要随便乱碰！

say:39:1410242034:1.text: My lab's not far, but the mine's a bit of a maze. Stick close! Put those long legs of yours— and your short paws—to work!
say:39:1410242034:1.source_cn: 我的研究所离这里不远，矿区的路有点难走，你们跟紧我！把...
say:39:1410242034:1.male: My lab's not far, but the mine's a bit of a maze. Stick close! Put those long legs of yours— and your short paws—to work!
say:39:1410242034:1.female: My lab's not far, but the mine's a bit of a maze. Stick close! Put those long legs of yours— and your short paws—to work!

say:41:1410242033:1.text: What?! Look, if I were dangerous, I would've fought you already! Just trust me and move it!
say:41:1410242033:1.source_cn: 你的疑心病真重……我不是坏人，否则早就跟你们打起来了！...
say:41:1410242033:1.male: What?! Look, if I were dangerous, I would've fought you already! Just trust me and move it!
say:41:1410242033:1.female: What?! Look, if I were dangerous, I would've fought you already! Just trust me and move it!

say:42:1410242016:1.text: You... fine! Ugh, this is the worst!
say:42:1410242016:1.male: You... fine! Ugh, this is the worst!
say:42:1410242016:1.female: You... fine! Ugh, this is the worst!

choice:18:1:2.text: We fell down here because of you.
choice:18:1:2.male: We fell down here because of you.
choice:18:1:2.female: We fell down here because of you.

say:44:1410242013:1.text: No way! I have work to do, and I'm not leaving until it's done!
say:44:1410242013:1.source_cn: 我才不去呢！我还有很重要的研究没完成，在那之前都不打算...

choice:15:1:2.text: We're taking you to the chief.
choice:15:1:2.source_cn: 我要带你去见深岩村的村长
choice:15:1:2.male: We're taking you to the chief.
choice:15:1:2.female: We're taking you to the chief.

say:45:1410242007:1.text: They're my kin, sure, but I don't deal with them much.
say:45:1410242007:1.source_cn: 虽然他们是我的同族，但我和现在的他们没什么关系！

choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 你与深岩村是什么关系？
